<div>


<p align="center" style="margin:0pt 0pt 12.0pt;text-align:center;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">AMENDMENT NO. 4 TO FORM 10</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 12.0pt;text-indent:36.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">This Amendment No. 4 to Form 10 amends and supplements the Form 10
filed by Avaya Inc., a Delaware corporation (the &#147;Company&#148;), with the
Securities and Exchange Commission (&#147;SEC&#148;) on June 20, 2000, as amended by
Amendment No. 1 to Form 10 filed on August 9, 2000, Amendment No. 2 to Form 10
filed on September 6, 2000 and Amendment No. 3 filed on August 14, 2000
(together, the &#147;Form 10&#148;).</font></p>

<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 12.0pt;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Item
11.&#160; Description of Registrant&#146;s
Securities to be Registered.</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 12.0pt;text-indent:36.0pt;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Item 11 of the Form 10 is amended and supplemented by adding the
following:</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 12.0pt;text-indent:36.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The Company announced on June 4, 2007 that it entered into an Agreement
and Plan of Merger (the &#147;Merger Agreement&#148;) dated as of June 4, 2007 among the
Company, Sierra Holdings Corp., a Delaware corporation (&#147;Parent&#148;), and Sierra
Merger Corp., a Delaware corporation and wholly owned subsidiary of Parent (&#147;Merger
Sub&#148;).&#160; Pursuant to the Merger Agreement,
upon the satisfaction of the terms and conditions set forth therein, Merger Sub
will be merged with and into the Company, with the Company continuing as the
surviving corporation and a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent (the &#147;Merger&#148;).</font></p>

<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 12.0pt;text-indent:36.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Immediately prior to the Company&#146;s execution of the Merger Agreement,
the Company executed Amendment No. 2 (the &#147;Second Amendment&#148;) to the Rights
Agreement, dated as of September 29, 2000, between the Company and The Bank of
New York, as Rights Agent, as amended on February 28, 2002 (as amended, the &#147;Rights
Agreement&#148;).</font></p>

<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 12.0pt;text-indent:36.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The Second Amendment provides that neither the execution of the Merger
Agreement nor the consummation of the Merger or other transactions contemplated
by the Merger Agreement will trigger the separation or exercise of the Rights
or any adverse event under the Rights Agreement. In particular, neither Parent,
Merger Sub nor any of their affiliates or associates shall be deemed to be an
Acquiring Person solely by reason of (i) the approval, adoption, execution, or
delivery of the Merger Agreement, (ii) the approval or consummation of the
Merger, (iii) the approval or consummation of any other transaction
contemplated by the Merger Agreement, or (iv) the announcement of any of the
above (each event described in subclauses (i), (ii), (iii) and (iv) is referred
to as an &#147;Exempted Transaction&#148;). In addition, the definitions of Distribution
Date and Shares Acquisition Date have been deemed not to occur by virtue of or
as a result of any Exempted Transaction.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 12.0pt;text-indent:36.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The Second Amendment also amends the definition of Final Expiration
Date to provide that it will be the earliest of (i) the close of business on
September 29, 2010 or (ii) immediately prior to the effective time of the
Merger.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 12.0pt;text-indent:36.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">In the event that the Merger Agreement is terminated or the Merger is
abandoned, then (i) the Second Amendment shall be of no further force and
effect and (ii) the Rights Agreement shall remain as it existed immediately
prior to the execution of the Second Amendment.</font></p>


 <p style="margin:24.0pt 0pt .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">2</font></p> <br><hr size="3" width="100%" noshade color="#010101" align="center">
